name: DR02
summary: The first humanoid rated IP66 — sealed against dust and heavy water jets — and specified from −20 °C to 55 °C, which takes it outdoors where almost every other humanoid stays in a warehouse. Forearms, whole arms and whole legs detach for quick field replacement, and it walks at 1.5 m/s with a 4 m/s sprint for patrol work.
notable: First humanoid with an IP66 all-weather rating
Modular limbs designed for fast field swaps
